capabilities: Render progress bars from fenced code blocks
Set bar title, current value and total via block attributes
Change bar color based on completion value
extras: Full documentation is hosted on a separate GitHub page rather than in the README; the author asks for Ko-fi support.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display visual progress bars inside notes.
summary: Progress bar renderer that creates customizable progress bars from fenced code blocks, with colors that change based on completion value.
